claim: For functions using AWS Lambda Managed Instances, asynchronous invocations and event source mapping invocations (except Amazon MQ and Amazon DocumentDB) support a maximum timeout of 5,400 seconds (90 minutes).
question: What is the maximum timeout for a Lambda Managed Instances function invoked asynchronously or through an event source mapping?

qualifiers.scope: per function on Lambda Managed Instances
qualifiers.condition: asynchronous invocations and event source mapping invocations, except Amazon MQ and Amazon DocumentDB

note: Not examinable yet: Lambda Managed Instances and the 90-minute timeout are GA after 2026-07-15 (see FRESHNESS 2026-09-09).
